Vocal_tract_note: Two simplified formant profiles, crossed with every F0. Acoustic model labels do not encode sex or gender and are not validated individual male/female voices.
Main_source: Rosenberg-style raised-cosine glottal flow, differentiated and passed through a fixed causal five-formant resonator cascade.
Independent_source: Harmonic excitation (sum of harmonics, amplitudes 1/k^1.5), same event-clock truth and formant cascade; not any estimator output.
Validation_conditions: Independent source clean; primary source compound stress (jitter 3%, shimmer 10%, alternating amplitudes 30%, 15 dB noise, soft boundary).
Truth: Exact source-cycle start/end times and periods generated before sampling; RFF normalized to actual first OFF / last ON reference periods. Jitter included in truth. Store all source events plus canonical 10 cycles per side.
